description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv' is already open in JASP. This is a real dataset (Field, 2013) from a study on academic performance with 103 students. Columns include: 'Code' (student ID), 'Revise' (hours spent revising), 'Exam' (exam score out of 100), 'Anxiety' (exam anxiety score), and 'Gender'. Using JASP's Regression module, run a Linear Regression. Set 'Exam' as the Dependent Variable. Add 'Revise' and 'Anxiety' as Covariates (predictors). Under Statistics, enable 'Descriptives', 'Model fit', and 'Estimates'. Leave all other settings at their defaults.
